body.title: Measure the VSIX delta and confirm the widened response leaves the JetBrains panel unaffected
body.summary: REVISED per critique: retitled and reduced from a verify-everything catch-all to the only two checks that genuinely cannot be done earlier. First, measure the VSIX size delta now that MARKED_SRC is actually bundled into this surface — the HLD flagged bundle growth as a risk and s1 is the Story that introduces it here. Second, confirm the cross-client contract: the four added keys leave the JetBrains ArtifactReviewViewDto parse working. That is already established by reading DaemonGateway.kt:1517, where parseView pulls six named keys field-by-field out of a Map<String, Any?> with no unknown-key rejection, so this is a confirmation rather than an integration risk. The per-task behavioural checks have moved into t4 and t6, where the changes that could break them live.
acceptanceChecks: the VSIX size delta attributable to this Story is measured and reported as a number, not an impression
the JetBrains ArtifactReviewViewDto parse is confirmed unaffected by the four added keys, citing parseView's field-by-field key reads
npx tsc --noEmit is clean across the repo
the full sweep passes, with any pre-existing unrelated failure named explicitly rather than absorbed into the result

the installed daemon is rebuilt and restarted so the widened projection is actually live — migration step 8, which no other task owns; until it runs the plugin compiles against the new shape but still receives the old six-member response

tests.name: package the VSIX and report the measured byte delta attributable to this Story
source-scan: parseView reads six named keys field-by-field with no unknown-key rejection, so the four added keys cannot break the JetBrains DTO
npx tsc --noEmit is clean across the repo
the full node:test sweep passes, with any pre-existing unrelated failure named explicitly
the installed daemon is rebuilt and restarted, and a freshly-opened document shows the projected records
